name: form-yields
of: A mechanism by which a form imposed on a pile, an order, a named axis, a product of dimensions, a partition, a hierarchy, a graph, a grid, a count, an alphabet, a symmetry, an algebra, a projection, or the list itself taken as complete, produces a member, an absence, or a distinction the pile did not hold, named with the form, what it makes visible, what it costs, the yield by the form's failure to hold, and the tell that the form rather than the pile produced the item, and sorted by who can vouch for the yield, from a cell the pile's neighbours fix on every side to a member the list builds from its own body against itself: the neighbours, the full cells, the rule's spacing, the other properties of a swapped pair, the strained cell's definition, then the symmetry, the operation, the axis's limit, then the enumerator at a collision, at a blank, at a slot, then the matrix's cell, the tree's leftovers, the ranks, then a recorded visit, a dated anchor, an outside prediction, and the list's own claim to be complete.
items: Empty cell: an order by one monotone property, folded into rows so that a second property recurs, leaves an address with full cells on every side, and the neighbours fix what must sit there before anyone has seen it, as the three gaps Mendeleev left in 1871 under aluminium, boron, and silicon, each with a predicted weight, density, and oxide, filled by gallium in 1875, scandium in 1879, and germanium in 1886, and the tenth corner of the baryon decuplet, whose mass the spacing of the other nine fixed before the omega-minus was found in 1964; the form is a product of an order and a period; what it makes visible is an absence with an address and a description; the cost is that every member must sit in a cell whether or not it wants to, which is where the rare earths went for decades, a row's worth of members crammed into one cell until the table grew a row for them; the yield by the form's failure to hold is that added row, a dimension the two-property table did not have and had to grow; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a cell with neighbours on fewer than two sides, since the eka-elements were interpolated from both sides and the two elements lighter than hydrogen that Mendeleev placed above helium in 1902, the ether he called newtonium and its companion coronium, were extrapolated from one side with nothing beyond them, so they read as a cell's name plus a hypothesis and never existed; observed; adds to discovery-delights' The missing tooth, the pleasure of pointing at what ought to be there, the mechanism that makes the pointing precise and the sign that the tooth was drawn on the gum; not Interior gap, where one order and a rule fix an address without fixing what fills it.

Forbidden corner: a product of dimensions makes every combination a cell, and a cell that its dimensions forbid by their own definitions, or that stays empty while its neighbours fill, is read as a law, until someone finds it occupied, as the rotational symmetries of a periodic lattice, where the product of lattice and rotation has no cell for a fivefold axis and the empty cell was a theorem for a century, proved from the lattice's periodicity and never read off its neighbours, until an aluminium–manganese alloy in 1982 diffracted with icosahedral symmetry, was called twinning by the most eminent chemist alive, and had the word crystal redefined around it in 1992 as whatever gives a discrete diffraction pattern, and the word-order features of languages, whose product has cells that are nearly empty, a verb-first language with postpositions, from which a universal was read and later softened to a tendency when the cell was found thinly occupied; the form is a product of dimensions read as a table of the possible; what it makes visible is a combination nobody has built or found, with the cell's coordinates as its description, which is how Zwicky filled sheets with propulsion systems nobody had tried; the cost is that the empty cell cannot say whether it is forbidden, unbuilt, or unvisited, and the reader supplies the reading the surrounding cells suggest; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the law's failure, the largest yield on this map, since an occupied forbidden cell forces a redefinition of the dimensions themselves, periodic against aperiodic order, absolute against statistical universal; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member named by its coordinates, say a solar-powered underwater ramjet, a cell's name plus a case that was never built and would not work, which is the reading the product's fullness invites; observed; the product as a universe to count against is a denominator and belongs to denominator-manufactures, and this item holds only what the empty cell yields; not Empty cell, where a monotone property runs through the cell and fixes its occupant, since a corner of a product has no such property and the occupant's description is the coordinates alone.

Interior gap: a single order with a rule for its spacing shows a step wider than the rule allows, and the width becomes an address that sends searchers there, as the Titius–Bode spacing that left nothing at 2.8 astronomical units between Mars and Jupiter, which drew a party of astronomers to divide the zodiac among themselves in 1800 and had Ceres found on the first night of 1801 by a man who was not yet in the party; the form is one order with a spacing rule; what it makes visible is where to look and nothing about what will be found, since the rule gave Ceres a distance and no size, and what was there was not a planet but a belt; the cost is that the searching is spent at the rule's address and not the sky's, and a rule fitted to six points is treated as a law; the yield by the form's failure to hold came in 1846 when Neptune sat at thirty units where the rule said thirty-nine, and the failure yielded the distinction between a spacing that is a law and a spacing that is one system's history, which the six fitted points could never have shown; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member described only as between its neighbours, with no property but its position, which is what the missing link was when a line was laid over what is a tree, an animal named by the gap and not by any bone; observed; not Empty cell, where a second property fixes what the address holds, since a gap in one order fixes only the address, and not Endpoint demand, which is the same rule run past the last member rather than between two.

Swapped pair: an order by a key puts two members in an order their other properties refuse, and the enumerator swaps them to keep the form, so the form now holds a pair whose position the key cannot explain, as tellurium, heavier than iodine, placed before it in 1869 so that iodine could sit under bromine, with argon before potassium and cobalt before nickel the same; the form is an order by a key; what it makes visible is that the key is a proxy, since the inverted pair is a member whose true position and whose key position differ, which is an absence in the key itself; the cost is the swap, a member kept in place by hand against the rule the table claims to run on, which any reader can call a fudge; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the hidden quantity, found in 1913 when Moseley read the charge of each nucleus off its X-ray line and every swapped pair fell into order on it, so that the failure of the weight order was the atomic number; the tell that the form manufactured the item is an inversion defended only by the form, with no property of the pair to point at, which is a swap made to keep the columns tidy and not to keep the neighbours right; observed; adds to model-collapse-markers, which reads a framework that reclassifies anomalies faster than it examines them, the one anomaly a form should keep by hand because it is the address of the key the form lacks; not Misfit, where a member strains the cell it is in, since here each member fits its cell and only the order between two cells is wrong.

Misfit: a partition that must place every member puts one where it does not belong, and the strain on the cell's definition is what yields, either a new cell or a rewritten definition, as the platypus, an egg-layer with fur and milk, placed among the mammals in 1799 with the cell's definition bent to take it, until a new order was made for it and the echidna, the viruses set on either side of the line between living and not, which the line still cannot hold, and Pluto, held as a planet from 1930 until the cell's definition was rewritten in 2006 to expel it, at which point the expelled member was given a cell named for what it was not, a dwarf planet being a planet that is not one; the form is a partition with the demand that every member sit somewhere; what it makes visible is the definition of the cell, which nobody had to write until a member strained it, so that the platypus is what made mammal a definition rather than a resemblance; the cost is the years in which the misfit is called a fraud or an anomaly, which is what its first describers suspected of the platypus, a hoax sewn from a duck and a mole; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the new cell, when the strain is honoured, or the sharpened definition, when it is not, and the difference between those two is a decision about the form and not about the animal; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member kept in its cell by the cell's definition and by nothing it shares with its neighbours, or a new cell named by negation and holding one expelled member; observed; adds to importance-detectors' Not on the menu, which reads a domain by what it will not serve, the member the domain served and then rewrote its menu to strike; not Swapped pair, where every member fits its cell and only an order between cells is wrong, and not Forced ancestor, where the strain is paid in a node above the members rather than in a member.

Mirror demand: a symmetry laid over a pile demands, for each member, the member it maps to, and the enumerator writes down the image before the world has shown one, as the electron's negative-energy twin that Dirac's equation demanded in 1928, which he first tried to read as the proton and which arrived as the positron in 1932, the antiparticle then demanded for every particle, and in a list of persuasion moves the counter to each move, which a symmetry of the list demands and the pile did not contain; the form is a symmetry, an operation that must carry members to members; what it makes visible is a member with every property fixed by its original and the operation, a stronger description than an empty cell gives, since the positron's mass and charge were known to the last figure before it was seen; the cost is a list doubled by rule, half of it unseen, and the temptation to read the demanded twin as a known member, as Dirac read it as the proton, which is the mirror's manufacture in its first form; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the asymmetry itself, a fact about the world that the pile alone could never have shown, since the mirror image of a weak decay was found in 1957 not to occur and the failure of the mirror was the discovery that the weak force tells left from right; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member that is its original with a sign changed and no case of its own, anti-, un-, the reverse of, a name built from the operation and one existing member; observed; not Closure demand, where the operation combines members and sheds a law each time it fails, since a symmetry pairs members and its failure is a single fact, and not Endpoint demand, which extrapolates along an axis rather than reflecting across one.

Closure demand: a rule that the pile be closed under an operation demands the result of applying the operation to members, and the results are new members that the operation names, until an application produces something the pile's kind cannot hold, as the negatives demanded by closure under subtraction, the square root of minus one demanded by closure under root extraction, then Hamilton's quaternions in 1843, which closed division in four dimensions at the price of commutativity, and the octonions, which closed it in eight at the price of associativity, after which Hurwitz proved in 1898 that the ladder stops; the form is an algebra, a demand that operations stay inside the list; what it makes visible is a member with a construction, the inverse of this, the composite of these two, and an identity, the do-nothing move that every closed list of moves acquires; the cost is members that exist to close the algebra and answer to nothing, a do-nothing move with no case, and a list doubled with the inverse of each member; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the property lost at each rung, since every extension that keeps closure drops a law the smaller pile obeyed, and the dropped law is a distinction the smaller pile could not state, having never seen it fail; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member named by an operation on other members, the inverse of, the sum of, with no case that is not that construction; observed; adds to mathematical-moves' Pass to the completion, a move on a problem, what the move does to a list and what it costs at each step; not Mirror demand, which pairs members under one operation and whose failure is a single fact, since closure combines members and fails by shedding a law each time it is extended.

Endpoint demand: once an order is given a name, a quantity that runs from less to more, each end of it demands the member at which the quantity runs out, and the enumerator supplies one whether or not the world has it, as the Beaufort scale's force twelve, described in 1805 as that which no canvas could withstand, by consequence because no number was to hand, and extended to seventeen in 1946 when typhoons turned out to carry more wind than the top had room for, the Kardashev scale's type three, a civilisation spending its galaxy's output, which no observation has produced and which was reached by running the exponent one more step, and in this atlas the axis of the map of option expiries, which after being named from clocks the holder never started to clocks the holder wrote was, in its author's own note, built to reach the member at its far end; the form is a named axis; what it makes visible is the limiting case, which is sometimes real, since the scale of hardness ends at diamond because diamond was there; the cost is an end member that is the axis's word with most or least in front of it; the yield by the form's failure to hold is a bound discovered, when the search for one more step finds there is none, which is a fact about the world the axis alone could not say; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member with no case, only the quantity at its limit, so that the item is the axis's own name and one more step; observed; adds to list-excellences' Edge inclusion, which credits a list for attending to its limiting cases, the mechanism by which a named axis conscripts them and the sign that a limiting case was conscripted rather than found; not Interior gap, which points between members.

Headword's quarrel: an order that claims nothing about the pile, letters or accession numbers, still forces a decision wherever two members would take the same address, and the decision is a distinction the pile did not hold, as the dictionary's one entry per spelling, which makes the editor decide whether the ear of corn and the ear that hears are one word with two senses or two words that happen to be spelled alike, a decision about descent that a pile of quotations never has to make, and the catalogue's one shelf mark per work, which makes a library decide where a book that is two books goes; the form is an order with no claim, chosen because it claims nothing; what it makes visible is the collision, and behind it the question the collision forces, one thing or two, which is the question of what the pile's unit is; the cost is nothing along the order, since an arbitrary neighbour teaches nothing and is known not to, and everything at the collision, where two things are welded into one entry by their spelling; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the homograph split, an entry broken into two because one-per-address could not hold what descent had made separate, so that the form that claims nothing is the one that forces the pile to say what one of it is; the tell that the form manufactured the item is an entry whose senses share nothing but their address, one word by the alphabet and two by every other reading; observed; the reversal on this map, the form with no claim, which yields no member and no absence and only a decision; not Count bound, where the decision is forced by a number rather than by a collision, and not Misfit, since nothing strains a cell, two things merely arrive at one.

Blank column: a schema that requires a value under every heading for every member puts, where a member has none, either the member out of the list or the blank into it as a kind, as the red list of threatened species, whose column for risk must be filled and whose species with nothing to fill it are listed under Data Deficient, a category that has held a fifth of the amphibians assessed and whose members share nothing but the list's ignorance of them, the census form's box for what the other boxes miss, and in this atlas the of-sentence's named-with clause, which demands of every item a carrier, a cost, and a tell, so that an item with no tell to name is either cut for not being a mechanism or admitted with its blank turned into a claim, a mechanism whose tell is that it has none; the form is a table of required parts; what it makes visible is the part the pile did not have, which is a finding about the item when the column is a gate, the item was not of the declared type, and a finding about the column when the blank recurs, the column is not universal and the members without it are a sub-type the form did not know it held; the cost is the blank promoted to a value, a kind whose only character is the form's failure to learn one, taught and counted beside the real kinds; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the sub-type, the members for which the column's question is not well posed, which the list can then fence off, as the red list fences off domesticates and hybrids, for whom extinction risk is not a question; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a value that is the absence of a value, deficient, unknown, other, not applicable, listed among the values; observed; not Misfit, where a member strains a cell it is in, since here the member is in no cell and the form makes one for its absence, and not Forced ancestor, whose negation-named node holds members that share a negative character of their own, no backbone, since Data Deficient's members share only the form's ignorance.

Count bound: a fixed number of slots, imposed before the pile is counted, forces the pile to be cut or padded to fit, and the cutting is a partition the pile did not hold while the padding is a member it did not have, as the ten commandments, whose number is fixed by the text that calls them ten and whose division into ten differs between the Jewish, the Catholic and Lutheran, and the Reformed numberings, so that what is one commandment in one church is two in another, the seven wonders, whose seven were kept while the members changed, and the thirteen to eighteen items this atlas's gate requires, which a map with twelve mechanisms meets by finding a thirteenth or by lifting a case to the rank of one; the form is a number; what it makes visible is the pile's own count against a demand, which is where the enumerator learns that the pile has eleven mechanisms and not sixteen, if the enumerator is willing to learn it; the cost is paid at the margin, the last slot filled or the last member expelled; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the pile's real count, discovered when the padding is visible or the cutting is refused; the tell that the form manufactured the item is that the last-added member reads as a cell's name plus a case and would not have been written for a bound one smaller, or that two members are one member cut at a joint the subject does not have; observed; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty, which credits a list for saying what it counts against, the mechanism by which a number decided in advance makes the count come out; not Endpoint demand, which fills an end of an axis, since a count bound fills a slot with no position.

Pairwise table: a matrix with a row and a column for every member demands an entry at every pair, and each entry is a relation the pile did not hold, some real, some forced by the cell, as Altshuller's contradiction matrix, thirty-nine parameters against thirty-nine, whose filled cells recommend inventive principles and whose empty cells are the honest ones, the interaction table of a factorial experiment, and the four to seven conditional edges this atlas's gate demands of every map, which a map with three real relations meets by writing a fourth; the form is a graph demanded through its adjacency matrix; what it makes visible is the pair nobody had put side by side, whose cell asks how these two relate and sometimes gets an answer, and the components, the sets of members with no entries between them, which show that the pile is two piles; the cost is an entry at every pair whether or not the pair has anything between it, since a blank cell reads as work not done rather than as a finding; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the pair for which no entry can be written, which is either the seam between two lists or the sign that the relation the table was built on does not run across the whole pile; the tell that the form manufactured the item is an edge whose label restates its two endpoints joined by and, a conditional whose antecedent cannot fail, or a relation that exists only because the matrix had a cell there; observed; adds to decision-tree-topologies' The lattice, a shape a decision path can take, the mechanism by which requiring the shape produces the edges that make it; not Forced ancestor, where the form demands a node, since here it demands a relation between nodes that already exist.

Forced ancestor: a hierarchy demands a node above every set of leftovers, and the demand is met by a node named for what its members are not, which holds until it is split, as Linnaeus's class Vermes, worms, which held every animal that was not a vertebrate or an insect, until Lamarck broke it into the invertebrate classes in 1801, and invertebrates and reptiles, each a name for the residue of a cut made elsewhere, a node with no character of its own that later readers of descent found to be no group at all, since the birds sit inside the reptiles and a group that excludes its own descendants is a shape a tree of descent cannot hold; the form is a tree with the rule that every leaf has a parent; what it makes visible is the residue, gathered in one place where it can be counted and eventually divided, which is a service, since Lamarck could break Vermes only because Linnaeus had put it all in one cell; the cost is that the residue is treated as a group, given a rank, and taught, so that a generation learns invertebrate as a kind of animal; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the network the tree could not draw, when the leftovers turn out to be joined across the tree's cuts, as genes crossing between lineages made the tree of life a web at its root, and a language with no relatives is written down as an isolate, a kind named for the tree's failure to attach it; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a node whose name contains a negation or a rank and no character, since a real group can be named by something its members share; observed; adds to list-excellences' Negative space, which credits a list for stating what it refuses, the node that refuses nothing and is where a hierarchy hides what it cannot place; not Misfit, where one member strains a cell, since here the strain is paid above the members in a node that does not exist.

Monotypic ladder: a hierarchy with fixed ranks demands a node at every rank between a leaf and the root, so a leaf with no relatives gets a chain of nodes each holding only the one below, each named by the leaf and a suffix, as Ginkgo biloba, sole species of its genus, sole genus of its family, sole family of its order, sole order of its class, sole class of its division, five names for one tree, the tuatara's family and order, and in this atlas a map that needs a thirteenth mechanism to meet the gate's floor and lifts one case to the rank, a mechanism with a single case named after it; the form is a hierarchy whose ranks must all be filled; what it makes visible is the leaf's solitude, the fact that nothing else survives on its branch, which the ladder states five times and the pile once; the cost is five names for one thing, taught and indexed as though each named a group; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the abandonment of rank, since a ladder of one-child nodes is one of the arguments by which the rank-free schools hold that rank is a property of the form and not of descent, so the failure yielded the distinction between a clade, which is real, and a rank, which is a shelf; the tell that the form manufactured the item is the purest on this map, a node with exactly one child named after that child, a cell's name plus one case with nothing else to say; observed; not Forced ancestor, whose node holds many members and is named for what they are not, since the ladder's nodes hold one member and are named for it, and the two fail differently, the ancestor by holding too much and the ladder by holding nothing beyond its child; not Count bound, which supplies the demand to fill, since the ladder supplies the item that fills it.

Quadrat: a grid laid over a territory or a period, with the rule that every cell be visited, turns the pile's silence into addresses, and the empty square becomes a place to send someone, as the ten-kilometre squares of the atlas of the British flora, whose blank squares sent recorders to the parts of the country nobody had botanised, the reading programme of the Oxford dictionary, which appealed for readers of the centuries its slips had not covered, and the circles of the Christmas bird count; the form is a partition of the space in which the members occur, not of the members; what it makes visible is the difference between an absence and an unvisited square, which no pile can show, since a pile holds only what was found, and with it the square whose emptiness survives the visit, the only absence a grid can vouch for and worth more than any member the grid produced; the cost is that every square must be visited whether or not anyone can reach it, so the recorders' hours go where the grid says and not where the members are; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the map of the recorders, since where the rule that every square be visited fails, at the sea, the private estate, the century whose books were never reprinted, the pattern of the blanks is a fact about the enumeration and not about the members, which the pile could never show; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a record that is a visit with nothing found, entered as though it were a member, or a distribution of members that follows the roads; observed; the grid as a universe to count against belongs to denominator-manufactures, and this item holds what the empty square sends someone to do; not Empty cell, where the neighbours fix what the cell holds, since a square of ground fixes nothing about what grows in it and can only be visited.

Which end is first: an order recovered from the members' resemblances has two directions and no way, from inside, to choose between them, so the direction is supplied by the hand that names the axis, and every claim that hangs on the direction, which end is the origin, which is the limit, which way the walk runs, is that hand's and not the order's, as Petrie's sequence of predynastic pottery in 1899, whose order the resemblances fixed and whose direction he took from the wavy handles that degenerate over time into a painted line, an anchor from outside the sequence, and in this atlas the seriation pass, which measures an order from embeddings and hands it to a model to name, with leave to reverse it, so the direction is set by whoever writes the axis's from and to; the form is a named direction on a measured order; what it makes visible is that a resemblance order is a line and not an arrow, which the walk's prose hides, since from A to B reads as a fact and is a choice; the cost is a walk whose every consequential adjacency is read the wrong way round if the hand chose wrong, and no reader can tell from the walk; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the anchor, since when the direction is contested the only thing that settles it is a member dated from outside the order, a stratum, a signed piece, a ledger line that says which item was seeded first, and finding the anchor is a fact about the pile the order could never supply; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a direction with no anchor named, an axis whose from and to were written by the same hand that named the quantity, which is how every authored walk in this atlas reads unless its note says where the direction came from; observed; adds to clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Drift against corpus, which yields position and never duration, the direction that position does not yield either; not Endpoint demand, which supplies the members at the ends, since this supplies which end is which and every endpoint stands on it.

Reified factor: a projection of a pile onto fewer dimensions produces an axis, and the axis is read as a member, a thing the pile contains, when it is a direction the projection would have produced from any pile with the same correlations, as the general factor read in 1904 out of the positive correlations among school subjects and treated since as a quantity a person has, which Thomson showed in 1916 would emerge from a pile of tests sharing many small overlapping causes and no general one, so that the axis is a property of positive correlation and not of the mind unless it predicts something outside the tests it was drawn from, the five factors of personality, whose number is the number the projection stopped at, and in this atlas the catalog's master axis, the Fiedler vector of the similarity graph over the lists' centroids, which the seriation drive names as though it were the atlas's subject and which any positively correlated pile would have supplied; the form is a projection; what it makes visible is a direction along which the pile varies most, which is real as a direction and is the yield when it is kept as one; the cost is a member with no case, the axis's own name, intelligence, extraversion, the atlas's theme, which is then measured, taught, and given a place on the list as though it were found; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the outside prediction that fails, since a factor that is the projection's artifact predicts nothing the projection did not already contain, and the failure is the distinction between a direction in the data and a cause in the world; the tell that the form manufactured the item is an item that is an axis, named by the projection's own word, with no member of the pile that is a case of it; observed, and contested in its central case, which is marked, since the general factor has predicted outside its tests and the two readings are still live; adds to passages-between-levels' Scatter as reading, where a width is a thing no member can have, the direction that no member can be either, and the mistake of listing it as one; not Endpoint demand, which manufactures a member at the end of a named axis, since here the manufactured member is the axis itself.

Diagonal: a list that claims to be complete, together with an operation that can read every entry, yields the member that differs from every entry in one respect each, and that member is outside the list by construction, as Cantor's 1891 argument that any list of the real numbers omits the number whose nth digit differs from the nth digit of the nth entry, and, for an enumerator, the item made by taking each listed mechanism and refusing its one defining respect, which is either a new member or the proof that the list's claim to be complete was the form's and not the pile's; the form is the list itself, taken as complete and as readable; what it makes visible is that completeness and closure under the reading operation cannot both hold, so that any list claiming both has manufactured one of them; the cost is that the diagonal member is built and not found, and is by construction as thin as its construction, a member that is not any of the above, which is the tell in its purest form unless a case is then found for it; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the failure itself, since the diagonal is the one form on this map whose whole yield is the proof that the form cannot hold, and what it yields is a fact about the size of the pile that no member could carry; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member defined by negating each listed member in turn, with no case that is not the negation; observed as mathematics, analytical as an enumerator's move; adds to witness-architectures' Writable counterexample, which needs a notation before a refutation can exist, the mechanism by which the list is its own notation and writes the refutation from its own body; not Closure demand, which extends a list by an operation on members and keeps the list, since the diagonal is applied to the whole list and ends it.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete, for an enumerator filling a catalog and a critic reading one: empty cells, swapped pairs, and the ether elements in the periodic table, Bode's gap and Ceres, Beaufort's twelfth force and its seventeenth, Petrie's wavy handles, quasicrystals and the crystallographic restriction, the platypus and Pluto, Linnaeus's Vermes and the ginkgo's five names, Dirac's hole and the parity experiment, quaternions and octonions, Altshuller's matrix, botanical atlases and the dictionary's reading programme, the ten commandments' numberings, the red list's Data Deficient, Thomson's bonds against the general factor, Cantor's diagonal, homograph splits; and this atlas's own gate, the item bound, the edge bound, the of-sentence's columns, the seriation pass's naming and reversal, the catalog's master axis, and the axis of option-expiries built to reach its ends.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. Diagonal is observed as mathematics and analytical as an enumerator's move. Reified factor's central case, the general factor, is contested and is marked as such; the five-factor case is used as a shape and not as a count. Forbidden corner's language case is a statistical universal and is marked. The atlas's own cases are read from the code, the gate, and the ledgers and are used as cases, not as the map. No item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable critic review applied 2026-09-13
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy of forms; a real table runs several of these at once, since the periodic table alone shows Empty cell, Swapped pair, and Misfit, and the list makes no claim to cover every form or every yield.

The seriation is an itinerary of who can vouch for the yield, not a ranking of forms by value or of yields by size; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, the dependencies, and the incompatibilities they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (Mendeleev's gaps and his ether, Ceres and Neptune, Beaufort's extension, Petrie's sequence dating, the platypus and Pluto, Vermes, Dirac's hole, Hurwitz's theorem, Altshuller's matrix, the red list's Data Deficient, the ten commandments' numberings, Thomson's critique of the general factor, Cantor's diagonal) are simplified to expose one mechanism each; dates are as commonly given, and nothing here is a history of any of them.

The atlas's own cases (the thirteen-to-eighteen item bound and the four-to-seven edge bound of the gate, the seriation pass that measures an order and hands it to a model to name with leave to reverse it, the catalog's master axis, and the option-expiries axis built to reach its ends) are read from the code and the ledgers and are cases, not the map; this map does not describe the repo.

Neighbouring maps in this fleet: denominator-manufactures holds the product and the grid as universes to count against, where this map holds what their empty cells yield; item-grains holds the unit, where Headword's quarrel holds the collision that forces the unit question; enumeration-stalls holds the process that stops, where Count bound holds the number that makes it stop or go on; composition-yields holds the measure/name split as a composition, where Which end is first holds what the naming hand adds to the measured order.

seriation.axis: Who can vouch for the yielded item, walked from a cell the pile's neighbours fix on every side to a member the list builds from its own body against itself: a cell fixed by its neighbours, a corner the full cells forbid, a gap in a rule, a pair the key gets wrong, a member the cell strains on, then a mirror the symmetry demands, a member the operation demands, a limit the axis demands, then a decision the alphabet forces, a blank the schema forces, a slot the count forces, then an edge the matrix supplies, a node the tree supplies, a ladder the ranks supply, then a square whose emptiness needs a recorded visit, a direction that needs a dated anchor, a factor that needs a prediction outside its tests, and the member the list constructs against its own claim to be complete.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of a form's value or of a yield's size. Empty cell opens it because its yield is vouched for by the pile on every side before anyone looks, and Diagonal closes it because its yield is vouched for by nothing but the list's own claim, turned against the list. The first five stops are yields the pile vouches for: neighbours fix a cell, full cells or the dimensions' own definitions forbid a corner whose occupant the pile then vouches for, a rule's spacing fixes a gap, a pair's other properties refuse the key's order, a member's own characters strain its cell; at each the enumerator can check the item against other members before the world confirms it. Misfit → Mirror demand is the first hinge: at Misfit the pile vouches against the form, at Mirror demand the form vouches for a member before the world has shown one, and the walk passes from finding to demanding; Mirror demand, Closure demand, and Endpoint demand are the three demands the world can then check, a positron, a quaternion, a seventeenth force. Endpoint demand → Headword's quarrel is the second hinge, from the last demand the world can settle to the first that only the enumerator can, since nothing in a pile of quotations says whether ear is one word or two; Headword's quarrel, Blank column, and Count bound are the three forced decisions, at a collision, at a blank, at a slot, where the form cannot be wrong and so cannot fail, and the yield is a decision rather than a member or an absence. Pairwise table, Forced ancestor, and Monotypic ladder are the three manufactures the form vouches for alone and the tell catches by name: an edge that restates its ends, a node named by not, a ladder of one name. Monotypic ladder → Quadrat is the consequential adjacency: the ladder is the purest manufacture on the map, a cell's name plus one case, readable as manufactured from the item's name alone, and Quadrat is the first yield whose status no name can carry, since an empty square reads the same whether it was visited or not; past this edge the check that reads an item's name for the form's vocabulary stops working, and Quadrat, Which end is first, and Reified factor need an anchor from outside the form, a recorded visit, a dated piece, a prediction the projection did not contain. Reified factor → Diagonal is the last step, from a form whose yield can be warranted only from outside to a form whose yield is the proof that the form cannot hold, and the walk ends where the list vouches against itself, which is the point the axis was built to reach and the one it is most exposed on, since the map's own axis has a direction that this author chose, and Which end is first says where that leaves it.

relations.from: Forbidden corner: a product of dimensions makes every combination a cell, and a cell that its dimensions forbid by their own definitions, or that stays empty while its neighbours fill, is read as a law, until someone finds it occupied, as the rotational symmetries of a periodic lattice, where the product of lattice and rotation has no cell for a fivefold axis and the empty cell was a theorem for a century, proved from the lattice's periodicity and never read off its neighbours, until an aluminium–manganese alloy in 1982 diffracted with icosahedral symmetry, was called twinning by the most eminent chemist alive, and had the word crystal redefined around it in 1992 as whatever gives a discrete diffraction pattern, and the word-order features of languages, whose product has cells that are nearly empty, a verb-first language with postpositions, from which a universal was read and later softened to a tendency when the cell was found thinly occupied; the form is a product of dimensions read as a table of the possible; what it makes visible is a combination nobody has built or found, with the cell's coordinates as its description, which is how Zwicky filled sheets with propulsion systems nobody had tried; the cost is that the empty cell cannot say whether it is forbidden, unbuilt, or unvisited, and the reader supplies the reading the surrounding cells suggest; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the law's failure, the largest yield on this map, since an occupied forbidden cell forces a redefinition of the dimensions themselves, periodic against aperiodic order, absolute against statistical universal; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member named by its coordinates, say a solar-powered underwater ramjet, a cell's name plus a case that was never built and would not work, which is the reading the product's fullness invites; observed; the product as a universe to count against is a denominator and belongs to denominator-manufactures, and this item holds only what the empty cell yields; not Empty cell, where a monotone property runs through the cell and fixes its occupant, since a corner of a product has no such property and the occupant's description is the coordinates alone.
relations.to: Misfit: a partition that must place every member puts one where it does not belong, and the strain on the cell's definition is what yields, either a new cell or a rewritten definition, as the platypus, an egg-layer with fur and milk, placed among the mammals in 1799 with the cell's definition bent to take it, until a new order was made for it and the echidna, the viruses set on either side of the line between living and not, which the line still cannot hold, and Pluto, held as a planet from 1930 until the cell's definition was rewritten in 2006 to expel it, at which point the expelled member was given a cell named for what it was not, a dwarf planet being a planet that is not one; the form is a partition with the demand that every member sit somewhere; what it makes visible is the definition of the cell, which nobody had to write until a member strained it, so that the platypus is what made mammal a definition rather than a resemblance; the cost is the years in which the misfit is called a fraud or an anomaly, which is what its first describers suspected of the platypus, a hoax sewn from a duck and a mole; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the new cell, when the strain is honoured, or the sharpened definition, when it is not, and the difference between those two is a decision about the form and not about the animal; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member kept in its cell by the cell's definition and by nothing it shares with its neighbours, or a new cell named by negation and holding one expelled member; observed; adds to importance-detectors' Not on the menu, which reads a domain by what it will not serve, the member the domain served and then rewrote its menu to strike; not Swapped pair, where every member fits its cell and only an order between cells is wrong, and not Forced ancestor, where the strain is paid in a node above the members rather than in a member.
relations.label: If a member appears in a cell the product had read as forbidden, it is first read as a misfit of a neighbouring cell, a twinned crystal rather than a fivefold one, and the corner yields its law's failure only after the misfit reading fails; so a form defends its law by re-celling the occupant, which is where a reader must look for the years between the finding and the redefinition; where the occupant cannot be re-celled, the law falls at once.

relations.from: Count bound: a fixed number of slots, imposed before the pile is counted, forces the pile to be cut or padded to fit, and the cutting is a partition the pile did not hold while the padding is a member it did not have, as the ten commandments, whose number is fixed by the text that calls them ten and whose division into ten differs between the Jewish, the Catholic and Lutheran, and the Reformed numberings, so that what is one commandment in one church is two in another, the seven wonders, whose seven were kept while the members changed, and the thirteen to eighteen items this atlas's gate requires, which a map with twelve mechanisms meets by finding a thirteenth or by lifting a case to the rank of one; the form is a number; what it makes visible is the pile's own count against a demand, which is where the enumerator learns that the pile has eleven mechanisms and not sixteen, if the enumerator is willing to learn it; the cost is paid at the margin, the last slot filled or the last member expelled; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the pile's real count, discovered when the padding is visible or the cutting is refused; the tell that the form manufactured the item is that the last-added member reads as a cell's name plus a case and would not have been written for a bound one smaller, or that two members are one member cut at a joint the subject does not have; observed; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty, which credits a list for saying what it counts against, the mechanism by which a number decided in advance makes the count come out; not Endpoint demand, which fills an end of an axis, since a count bound fills a slot with no position.
relations.to: Misfit: a partition that must place every member puts one where it does not belong, and the strain on the cell's definition is what yields, either a new cell or a rewritten definition, as the platypus, an egg-layer with fur and milk, placed among the mammals in 1799 with the cell's definition bent to take it, until a new order was made for it and the echidna, the viruses set on either side of the line between living and not, which the line still cannot hold, and Pluto, held as a planet from 1930 until the cell's definition was rewritten in 2006 to expel it, at which point the expelled member was given a cell named for what it was not, a dwarf planet being a planet that is not one; the form is a partition with the demand that every member sit somewhere; what it makes visible is the definition of the cell, which nobody had to write until a member strained it, so that the platypus is what made mammal a definition rather than a resemblance; the cost is the years in which the misfit is called a fraud or an anomaly, which is what its first describers suspected of the platypus, a hoax sewn from a duck and a mole; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the new cell, when the strain is honoured, or the sharpened definition, when it is not, and the difference between those two is a decision about the form and not about the animal; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member kept in its cell by the cell's definition and by nothing it shares with its neighbours, or a new cell named by negation and holding one expelled member; observed; adds to importance-detectors' Not on the menu, which reads a domain by what it will not serve, the member the domain served and then rewrote its menu to strike; not Swapped pair, where every member fits its cell and only an order between cells is wrong, and not Forced ancestor, where the strain is paid in a node above the members rather than in a member.
relations.label: If the count is a ceiling and the pile is long, the enumerator expels, and the expelled member returns as a misfit that strains whatever cell it is pushed into, a ninth planet pushed into a cell named for what it is not; where the count is a floor, the same bound pads instead and the pile gains a member rather than losing one, which is the other branch of the fork.

relations.from: Count bound: a fixed number of slots, imposed before the pile is counted, forces the pile to be cut or padded to fit, and the cutting is a partition the pile did not hold while the padding is a member it did not have, as the ten commandments, whose number is fixed by the text that calls them ten and whose division into ten differs between the Jewish, the Catholic and Lutheran, and the Reformed numberings, so that what is one commandment in one church is two in another, the seven wonders, whose seven were kept while the members changed, and the thirteen to eighteen items this atlas's gate requires, which a map with twelve mechanisms meets by finding a thirteenth or by lifting a case to the rank of one; the form is a number; what it makes visible is the pile's own count against a demand, which is where the enumerator learns that the pile has eleven mechanisms and not sixteen, if the enumerator is willing to learn it; the cost is paid at the margin, the last slot filled or the last member expelled; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the pile's real count, discovered when the padding is visible or the cutting is refused; the tell that the form manufactured the item is that the last-added member reads as a cell's name plus a case and would not have been written for a bound one smaller, or that two members are one member cut at a joint the subject does not have; observed; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty, which credits a list for saying what it counts against, the mechanism by which a number decided in advance makes the count come out; not Endpoint demand, which fills an end of an axis, since a count bound fills a slot with no position.
relations.to: Monotypic ladder: a hierarchy with fixed ranks demands a node at every rank between a leaf and the root, so a leaf with no relatives gets a chain of nodes each holding only the one below, each named by the leaf and a suffix, as Ginkgo biloba, sole species of its genus, sole genus of its family, sole family of its order, sole order of its class, sole class of its division, five names for one tree, the tuatara's family and order, and in this atlas a map that needs a thirteenth mechanism to meet the gate's floor and lifts one case to the rank, a mechanism with a single case named after it; the form is a hierarchy whose ranks must all be filled; what it makes visible is the leaf's solitude, the fact that nothing else survives on its branch, which the ladder states five times and the pile once; the cost is five names for one thing, taught and indexed as though each named a group; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the abandonment of rank, since a ladder of one-child nodes is one of the arguments by which the rank-free schools hold that rank is a property of the form and not of descent, so the failure yielded the distinction between a clade, which is real, and a rank, which is a shelf; the tell that the form manufactured the item is the purest on this map, a node with exactly one child named after that child, a cell's name plus one case with nothing else to say; observed; not Forced ancestor, whose node holds many members and is named for what they are not, since the ladder's nodes hold one member and are named for it, and the two fail differently, the ancestor by holding too much and the ladder by holding nothing beyond its child; not Count bound, which supplies the demand to fill, since the ladder supplies the item that fills it.
relations.label: If the count is a floor and the pile is short, the last slot is filled by lifting a case to the rank of a mechanism, which is a monotypic node, a kind with one member named after it, so a padded list can be read for its padding by finding the items with one case and a name that is that case's; where the count is a ceiling, the same bound expels instead, and the tell to read for is a member cut at a joint the subject does not have.

relations.from: Quadrat: a grid laid over a territory or a period, with the rule that every cell be visited, turns the pile's silence into addresses, and the empty square becomes a place to send someone, as the ten-kilometre squares of the atlas of the British flora, whose blank squares sent recorders to the parts of the country nobody had botanised, the reading programme of the Oxford dictionary, which appealed for readers of the centuries its slips had not covered, and the circles of the Christmas bird count; the form is a partition of the space in which the members occur, not of the members; what it makes visible is the difference between an absence and an unvisited square, which no pile can show, since a pile holds only what was found, and with it the square whose emptiness survives the visit, the only absence a grid can vouch for and worth more than any member the grid produced; the cost is that every square must be visited whether or not anyone can reach it, so the recorders' hours go where the grid says and not where the members are; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the map of the recorders, since where the rule that every square be visited fails, at the sea, the private estate, the century whose books were never reprinted, the pattern of the blanks is a fact about the enumeration and not about the members, which the pile could never show; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a record that is a visit with nothing found, entered as though it were a member, or a distribution of members that follows the roads; observed; the grid as a universe to count against belongs to denominator-manufactures, and this item holds what the empty square sends someone to do; not Empty cell, where the neighbours fix what the cell holds, since a square of ground fixes nothing about what grows in it and can only be visited.
relations.to: Empty cell: an order by one monotone property, folded into rows so that a second property recurs, leaves an address with full cells on every side, and the neighbours fix what must sit there before anyone has seen it, as the three gaps Mendeleev left in 1871 under aluminium, boron, and silicon, each with a predicted weight, density, and oxide, filled by gallium in 1875, scandium in 1879, and germanium in 1886, and the tenth corner of the baryon decuplet, whose mass the spacing of the other nine fixed before the omega-minus was found in 1964; the form is a product of an order and a period; what it makes visible is an absence with an address and a description; the cost is that every member must sit in a cell whether or not it wants to, which is where the rare earths went for decades, a row's worth of members crammed into one cell until the table grew a row for them; the yield by the form's failure to hold is that added row, a dimension the two-property table did not have and had to grow; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a cell with neighbours on fewer than two sides, since the eka-elements were interpolated from both sides and the two elements lighter than hydrogen that Mendeleev placed above helium in 1902, the ether he called newtonium and its companion coronium, were extrapolated from one side with nothing beyond them, so they read as a cell's name plus a hypothesis and never existed; observed; adds to discovery-delights' The missing tooth, the pleasure of pointing at what ought to be there, the mechanism that makes the pointing precise and the sign that the tooth was drawn on the gum; not Interior gap, where one order and a rule fix an address without fixing what fills it.
relations.label: If an empty cell has a monotone property running through it from full neighbours, it yields a described member before anyone looks; if it is a square of ground or a century of books, it yields only an errand, and until the errand is run and recorded the emptiness says nothing; so the same empty cell yields a prediction or a question according to whether the form's dimensions carry a property across it, and a bare grid over space carries none of its own, so that whatever predicts an unvisited square's contents, a climate gradient, a neighbouring square's records, is a property laid over the grid and not the grid, and the prediction is that property's to vouch for.

relations.from: Endpoint demand: once an order is given a name, a quantity that runs from less to more, each end of it demands the member at which the quantity runs out, and the enumerator supplies one whether or not the world has it, as the Beaufort scale's force twelve, described in 1805 as that which no canvas could withstand, by consequence because no number was to hand, and extended to seventeen in 1946 when typhoons turned out to carry more wind than the top had room for, the Kardashev scale's type three, a civilisation spending its galaxy's output, which no observation has produced and which was reached by running the exponent one more step, and in this atlas the axis of the map of option expiries, which after being named from clocks the holder never started to clocks the holder wrote was, in its author's own note, built to reach the member at its far end; the form is a named axis; what it makes visible is the limiting case, which is sometimes real, since the scale of hardness ends at diamond because diamond was there; the cost is an end member that is the axis's word with most or least in front of it; the yield by the form's failure to hold is a bound discovered, when the search for one more step finds there is none, which is a fact about the world the axis alone could not say; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member with no case, only the quantity at its limit, so that the item is the axis's own name and one more step; observed; adds to list-excellences' Edge inclusion, which credits a list for attending to its limiting cases, the mechanism by which a named axis conscripts them and the sign that a limiting case was conscripted rather than found; not Interior gap, which points between members.
relations.to: Which end is first: an order recovered from the members' resemblances has two directions and no way, from inside, to choose between them, so the direction is supplied by the hand that names the axis, and every claim that hangs on the direction, which end is the origin, which is the limit, which way the walk runs, is that hand's and not the order's, as Petrie's sequence of predynastic pottery in 1899, whose order the resemblances fixed and whose direction he took from the wavy handles that degenerate over time into a painted line, an anchor from outside the sequence, and in this atlas the seriation pass, which measures an order from embeddings and hands it to a model to name, with leave to reverse it, so the direction is set by whoever writes the axis's from and to; the form is a named direction on a measured order; what it makes visible is that a resemblance order is a line and not an arrow, which the walk's prose hides, since from A to B reads as a fact and is a choice; the cost is a walk whose every consequential adjacency is read the wrong way round if the hand chose wrong, and no reader can tell from the walk; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the anchor, since when the direction is contested the only thing that settles it is a member dated from outside the order, a stratum, a signed piece, a ledger line that says which item was seeded first, and finding the anchor is a fact about the pile the order could never supply; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a direction with no anchor named, an axis whose from and to were written by the same hand that named the quantity, which is how every authored walk in this atlas reads unless its note says where the direction came from; observed; adds to clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Drift against corpus, which yields position and never duration, the direction that position does not yield either; not Endpoint demand, which supplies the members at the ends, since this supplies which end is which and every endpoint stands on it.
relations.label: If the axis's direction is unanchored, the two extreme members of the measured order stay where they are but which is most and which is least swaps with the direction, and the member conscripted one step past each end was conscripted for lying beyond the most of a quantity nobody measured; so a conscripted endpoint stands only on whatever fixed the direction, and a walk whose direction was chosen by the hand that named the axis has manufactured its limits together with its arrow; where a dated anchor fixed the direction, the limits can be checked one at a time.

relations.from: Pairwise table: a matrix with a row and a column for every member demands an entry at every pair, and each entry is a relation the pile did not hold, some real, some forced by the cell, as Altshuller's contradiction matrix, thirty-nine parameters against thirty-nine, whose filled cells recommend inventive principles and whose empty cells are the honest ones, the interaction table of a factorial experiment, and the four to seven conditional edges this atlas's gate demands of every map, which a map with three real relations meets by writing a fourth; the form is a graph demanded through its adjacency matrix; what it makes visible is the pair nobody had put side by side, whose cell asks how these two relate and sometimes gets an answer, and the components, the sets of members with no entries between them, which show that the pile is two piles; the cost is an entry at every pair whether or not the pair has anything between it, since a blank cell reads as work not done rather than as a finding; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the pair for which no entry can be written, which is either the seam between two lists or the sign that the relation the table was built on does not run across the whole pile; the tell that the form manufactured the item is an edge whose label restates its two endpoints joined by and, a conditional whose antecedent cannot fail, or a relation that exists only because the matrix had a cell there; observed; adds to decision-tree-topologies' The lattice, a shape a decision path can take, the mechanism by which requiring the shape produces the edges that make it; not Forced ancestor, where the form demands a node, since here it demands a relation between nodes that already exist.
relations.to: Reified factor: a projection of a pile onto fewer dimensions produces an axis, and the axis is read as a member, a thing the pile contains, when it is a direction the projection would have produced from any pile with the same correlations, as the general factor read in 1904 out of the positive correlations among school subjects and treated since as a quantity a person has, which Thomson showed in 1916 would emerge from a pile of tests sharing many small overlapping causes and no general one, so that the axis is a property of positive correlation and not of the mind unless it predicts something outside the tests it was drawn from, the five factors of personality, whose number is the number the projection stopped at, and in this atlas the catalog's master axis, the Fiedler vector of the similarity graph over the lists' centroids, which the seriation drive names as though it were the atlas's subject and which any positively correlated pile would have supplied; the form is a projection; what it makes visible is a direction along which the pile varies most, which is real as a direction and is the yield when it is kept as one; the cost is a member with no case, the axis's own name, intelligence, extraversion, the atlas's theme, which is then measured, taught, and given a place on the list as though it were found; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the outside prediction that fails, since a factor that is the projection's artifact predicts nothing the projection did not already contain, and the failure is the distinction between a direction in the data and a cause in the world; the tell that the form manufactured the item is an item that is an axis, named by the projection's own word, with no member of the pile that is a case of it; observed, and contested in its central case, which is marked, since the general factor has predicted outside its tests and the two readings are still live; adds to passages-between-levels' Scatter as reading, where a width is a thing no member can have, the direction that no member can be either, and the mistake of listing it as one; not Endpoint demand, which manufactures a member at the end of a named axis, since here the manufactured member is the axis itself.
relations.label: If every pair is scored and the scores are positive, a projection of the matrix yields a first axis whatever the pile is, since positive correlation alone supplies one, so filling the table manufactures the factor that the projection then names; where cells are left blank for pairs with nothing between them, the first axis is warranted only by the filled cells and can be checked against the blanks.

relations.from: Closure demand: a rule that the pile be closed under an operation demands the result of applying the operation to members, and the results are new members that the operation names, until an application produces something the pile's kind cannot hold, as the negatives demanded by closure under subtraction, the square root of minus one demanded by closure under root extraction, then Hamilton's quaternions in 1843, which closed division in four dimensions at the price of commutativity, and the octonions, which closed it in eight at the price of associativity, after which Hurwitz proved in 1898 that the ladder stops; the form is an algebra, a demand that operations stay inside the list; what it makes visible is a member with a construction, the inverse of this, the composite of these two, and an identity, the do-nothing move that every closed list of moves acquires; the cost is members that exist to close the algebra and answer to nothing, a do-nothing move with no case, and a list doubled with the inverse of each member; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the property lost at each rung, since every extension that keeps closure drops a law the smaller pile obeyed, and the dropped law is a distinction the smaller pile could not state, having never seen it fail; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member named by an operation on other members, the inverse of, the sum of, with no case that is not that construction; observed; adds to mathematical-moves' Pass to the completion, a move on a problem, what the move does to a list and what it costs at each step; not Mirror demand, which pairs members under one operation and whose failure is a single fact, since closure combines members and fails by shedding a law each time it is extended.
relations.to: Diagonal: a list that claims to be complete, together with an operation that can read every entry, yields the member that differs from every entry in one respect each, and that member is outside the list by construction, as Cantor's 1891 argument that any list of the real numbers omits the number whose nth digit differs from the nth digit of the nth entry, and, for an enumerator, the item made by taking each listed mechanism and refusing its one defining respect, which is either a new member or the proof that the list's claim to be complete was the form's and not the pile's; the form is the list itself, taken as complete and as readable; what it makes visible is that completeness and closure under the reading operation cannot both hold, so that any list claiming both has manufactured one of them; the cost is that the diagonal member is built and not found, and is by construction as thin as its construction, a member that is not any of the above, which is the tell in its purest form unless a case is then found for it; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the failure itself, since the diagonal is the one form on this map whose whole yield is the proof that the form cannot hold, and what it yields is a fact about the size of the pile that no member could carry; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a member defined by negating each listed member in turn, with no case that is not the negation; observed as mathematics, analytical as an enumerator's move; adds to witness-architectures' Writable counterexample, which needs a notation before a refutation can exist, the mechanism by which the list is its own notation and writes the refutation from its own body; not Closure demand, which extends a list by an operation on members and keeps the list, since the diagonal is applied to the whole list and ends it.
relations.label: If the operation the list is closed under can be applied to the list as a whole, the closure yields a member outside every count the list can reach, so closure and completeness are incompatible and a list that claims both has manufactured one of them; where the operation reaches only members and never the list, closure and completeness can both hold, and the list's claim to be complete must then be vouched for by something other than its closure.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does a form laid over a pile produce a member, an absence, or a distinction the pile did not hold, what does each form cost, what does its failure yield, and how can a reader tell that the form and not the pile produced an item?
exploration.changed_question: For which forms can the failure be seen from inside the form at all, and which yields need an anchor the form cannot supply? Breath one assumed that a form's failure to hold is visible, a pair out of order, a member straining a cell, a corner occupied, a mirror image missing, and it found that every manufactured item carries its manufacture in its name, coordinates, a negation, an operation on a member, the axis's word plus most, between two names, so that a critic could read a list for the form's vocabulary. Pressing on that tell produced the reversal and the decisions, Headword's quarrel, Blank column, and Count bound, forms that cannot be wrong and so cannot fail and yield only a choice, and then the forms whose yield no name can carry: the empty square that may only be unvisited, the direction of a measured order, the axis of a projection, whose warrant sits outside the form in a recorded visit, a dated anchor, an outside prediction. Monotypic ladder, the purest cell's-name-plus-case, fixed where the name test stops working. The question turned from what the form yields to who can vouch for it.
exploration.new_member: Which end is first: an order recovered from the members' resemblances has two directions and no way, from inside, to choose between them, so the direction is supplied by the hand that names the axis, and every claim that hangs on the direction, which end is the origin, which is the limit, which way the walk runs, is that hand's and not the order's, as Petrie's sequence of predynastic pottery in 1899, whose order the resemblances fixed and whose direction he took from the wavy handles that degenerate over time into a painted line, an anchor from outside the sequence, and in this atlas the seriation pass, which measures an order from embeddings and hands it to a model to name, with leave to reverse it, so the direction is set by whoever writes the axis's from and to; the form is a named direction on a measured order; what it makes visible is that a resemblance order is a line and not an arrow, which the walk's prose hides, since from A to B reads as a fact and is a choice; the cost is a walk whose every consequential adjacency is read the wrong way round if the hand chose wrong, and no reader can tell from the walk; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the anchor, since when the direction is contested the only thing that settles it is a member dated from outside the order, a stratum, a signed piece, a ledger line that says which item was seeded first, and finding the anchor is a fact about the pile the order could never supply; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a direction with no anchor named, an axis whose from and to were written by the same hand that named the quantity, which is how every authored walk in this atlas reads unless its note says where the direction came from; observed; adds to clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Drift against corpus, which yields position and never duration, the direction that position does not yield either; not Endpoint demand, which supplies the members at the ends, since this supplies which end is which and every endpoint stands on it.
