priorities.why: Its carriers are in this repository: every grown map's seriation note says or fails to say where its direction came from, and every map's ledger says which breath admitted each item, so the claim that an authored axis conscripts its endpoints after its direction is chosen can be checked without a model call and without anyone's cooperation.
priorities.next_question: For each grown map, take the two items the axis names as its ends and read the ledger for the breath that admitted each; count how often an endpoint was admitted in the second breath against the map's own rate of second-breath admissions. If endpoints arrive in breath two above that rate, the axis demanded them and the direction was chosen before the ends were found; then read each seriation note for a stated anchor and see whether the maps with one show the effect less.

priorities.item: Reified factor: a projection of a pile onto fewer dimensions produces an axis, and the axis is read as a member, a thing the pile contains, when it is a direction the projection would have produced from any pile with the same correlations, as the general factor read in 1904 out of the positive correlations among school subjects and treated since as a quantity a person has, which Thomson showed in 1916 would emerge from a pile of tests sharing many small overlapping causes and no general one, so that the axis is a property of positive correlation and not of the mind unless it predicts something outside the tests it was drawn from, the five factors of personality, whose number is the number the projection stopped at, and in this atlas the catalog's master axis, the Fiedler vector of the similarity graph over the lists' centroids, which the seriation drive names as though it were the atlas's subject and which any positively correlated pile would have supplied; the form is a projection; what it makes visible is a direction along which the pile varies most, which is real as a direction and is the yield when it is kept as one; the cost is a member with no case, the axis's own name, intelligence, extraversion, the atlas's theme, which is then measured, taught, and given a place on the list as though it were found; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the outside prediction that fails, since a factor that is the projection's artifact predicts nothing the projection did not already contain, and the failure is the distinction between a direction in the data and a cause in the world; the tell that the form manufactured the item is an item that is an axis, named by the projection's own word, with no member of the pile that is a case of it; observed, and contested in its central case, which is marked, since the general factor has predicted outside its tests and the two readings are still live; adds to passages-between-levels' Scatter as reading, where a width is a thing no member can have, the direction that no member can be either, and the mistake of listing it as one; not Endpoint demand, which manufactures a member at the end of a named axis, since here the manufactured member is the axis itself.
priorities.why: Low confidence that the catalog's master axis is an artifact of positive similarity alone, since a real subject running through the atlas would produce the same first eigenvector; high generative promise, because if the axis predicts nothing outside its own similarity matrix, then every name given to a projection's first axis in this practice is a manufactured member, and the naming step should be demoted from a claim to a caption.
priorities.next_question: Take the catalog's master axis from the seriation drive and test whether a list's position on it predicts anything the embeddings did not contain: which lists other lists cite in their adjacency clauses, which maps a fresh critic returns for another breath, which lists the atlas's readers open. If position on the axis predicts none of these beyond what raw similarity predicts, the axis is a direction and not a subject, and the atlas should stop naming it as one; if it predicts one, the name has earned a case.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after widening Forbidden corner's mechanism to cover its deductive central case, reslotting Quadrat's cost, failure yield, and tell, correcting Monotypic ladder's gate floor and its historical claim, cutting Petrie from Swapped pair, reconciling Blank column's boundary clause with Forced ancestor, and repairing four edge consequents that overreached; no item cut, all four breath-two admissions found to carry mechanisms.

neighbors.left: Forced ancestor: a hierarchy demands a node above every set of leftovers, and the demand is met by a node named for what its members are not, which holds until it is split, as Linnaeus's class Vermes, worms, which held every animal that was not a vertebrate or an insect, until Lamarck broke it into the invertebrate classes in 1801, and invertebrates and reptiles, each a name for the residue of a cut made elsewhere, a node with no character of its own that later readers of descent found to be no group at all, since the birds sit inside the reptiles and a group that excludes its own descendants is a shape a tree of descent cannot hold; the form is a tree with the rule that every leaf has a parent; what it makes visible is the residue, gathered in one place where it can be counted and eventually divided, which is a service, since Lamarck could break Vermes only because Linnaeus had put it all in one cell; the cost is that the residue is treated as a group, given a rank, and taught, so that a generation learns invertebrate as a kind of animal; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the network the tree could not draw, when the leftovers turn out to be joined across the tree's cuts, as genes crossing between lineages made the tree of life a web at its root, and a language with no relatives is written down as an isolate, a kind named for the tree's failure to attach it; the tell that the form manufactured the item is a node whose name contains a negation or a rank and no character, since a real group can be named by something its members share; observed; adds to list-excellences' Negative space, which credits a list for stating what it refuses, the node that refuses nothing and is where a hierarchy hides what it cannot place; not Misfit, where one member strains a cell, since here the strain is paid above the members in a node that does not exist.
neighbors.right: Monotypic ladder: a hierarchy with fixed ranks demands a node at every rank between a leaf and the root, so a leaf with no relatives gets a chain of nodes each holding only the one below, each named by the leaf and a suffix, as Ginkgo biloba, sole species of its genus, sole genus of its family, sole family of its order, sole order of its class, sole class of its division, five names for one tree, the tuatara's family and order, and in this atlas a map that needs a thirteenth mechanism to meet the gate's floor and lifts one case to the rank, a mechanism with a single case named after it; the form is a hierarchy whose ranks must all be filled; what it makes visible is the leaf's solitude, the fact that nothing else survives on its branch, which the ladder states five times and the pile once; the cost is five names for one thing, taught and indexed as though each named a group; the yield by the form's failure to hold is the abandonment of rank, since a ladder of one-child nodes is one of the arguments by which the rank-free schools hold that rank is a property of the form and not of descent, so the failure yielded the distinction between a clade, which is real, and a rank, which is a shelf; the tell that the form manufactured the item is the purest on this map, a node with exactly one child named after that child, a cell's name plus one case with nothing else to say; observed; not Forced ancestor, whose node holds many members and is named for what they are not, since the ladder's nodes hold one member and are named for it, and the two fail differently, the ancestor by holding too much and the ladder by holding nothing beyond its child; not Count bound, which supplies the demand to fill, since the ladder supplies the item that fills it.
neighbors.separating_case: Give a botanist a hierarchy of ranks and two piles: ninety-nine species that fit no existing group, and one species with no relatives at all. The ninety-nine get one node above them named for what they are not, worms, and the node can be studied, counted, and eventually broken into groups that share something. The loner gets five nodes above it, each named for the loner and a suffix, and no node can be broken because each holds one. Both nodes are the tree's manufacture. The ancestor fails by holding too much and yields when it splits; the ladder fails by holding nothing beyond its child and yields when the rank is abandoned. A reader catches the first by a name built of not and the second by a chain of names built of one name, and a list padded to a count shows the second and not the first.

checks.boundary_case: The heading after the fact, a table of contents laid over a finished pile that groups what was already grouped, is the tempting nonmember and is out: it forces no member, no absence, and no decision, so it yields nothing the pile did not hold, and a form that cannot fail and forces no choice is not of the declared type. Also out is the member that arrives by analogy from another domain, since it comes from outside the pile and not from a form laid over it, and the product of dimensions or the grid taken as a universe to count against, which is a denominator and denominator-manufactures' business; the product and the grid are in only through what their empty cells yield.
checks.form_inference: The map shows what the walk conceals. Count bound forks: the same number pads or expels according to whether it is a floor or a ceiling, and the two branches land far apart on the walk, one as a monotypic ladder the tell catches and one as a misfit that later rewrites a cell. Endpoint demand depends on Which end is first: every endpoint stands on a direction, so the walk's own first and last members are downstream of a direction this author chose, which the walk cannot say about itself and the edge does. Quadrat and Empty cell are incompatible readings of one emptiness: a prediction where a property runs across the cell, an errand where none does. Closure and completeness are incompatible, so a list that claims both has made one of them up. From the bare pile a reader could not tell which manufactured items are catchable by their names and which are not; the map says that the name test, does the item read as its cell's name plus a case, catches the decisions and the manufactures and is blind past Monotypic ladder, where only an anchor from outside the form can vouch, so a critic who reads only the items cannot judge Quadrat, Which end is first, or Reified factor at all.
checks.target_preserved: Fable critic (fresh context, 2026-09-13) judged the target preserved, not a self-read: each item names a distinct form, what it makes visible, its cost, its failure yield, and its tell; the strange members (a form that claims nothing and still forces a decision, a list that writes its own refutation from its own body, an axis whose direction is the naming hand's) stand as mechanisms with their modality marked; the critic tested the four breath-two admissions at the item ceiling against the map's own Count bound tell and found each carrying a mechanism with a separating case, and the map's own Pairwise table tell caught overreach in four of its seven edge labels, repaired in place.
